digest.component_or_area: FILE_IMPACT event reducer and set-file-impact CLI/library/MCP surfaces
propositions: Empty file_impact is overloaded, conflating 'author forgot' with 'no repo file changes', so a third explicit 'none' state is added to the data model.
The FILE_IMPACT event gains optional file_impact_scope and no_file_impact_reason keys, with process_file_impact deriving one of paths/none/undeclared via last-writer-wins replacement.
set-file-impact moves from the fixed-arity _REGISTRY to the variadic _ARGV_REGISTRY to support a new '--none <reason>' form while preserving the JSON-array form byte-for-byte.
Exactly one of the array or --none forms must be present; the reason requires at least 10 non-whitespace characters, else usage error exit 2 with no event written.

A new library function get_file_impact_scope returns {kind, reason, paths} and an MCP tool declare_no_file_impact writes the same state as the CLI, classified as a string-ack advertiser with no outputSchema.
No gate behavior changes here; consumers are wired in later stories and only generated CLI/MCP reference artifacts are regenerated for the drift gate.
